code_observation: Both implementations compute coarse per-logit-grid class IDs. Pixels whose four source corners agree (or degenerate same-class edge/single-point cases) take a direct-class shortcut. Mixed-corner locations execute per-class bilinear interpolation. V2 additionally hoists checks over horizontal runs and fills shortcut spans with memset.
relation_to_measurement: This is a real data-dependent amount of postprocessing work and is consistent with the measured boundary-density/post-time association. The final-mask boundary proxy is not a direct counter of interpolated pixels and this observation does not isolate total latency causally.
important_amplitude_limit: Measured per-image mean post ranges: V0 5.656486..7.541792 ms; V2 1.799569..4.101389 ms. These runs do not explain a historical40ms-wide whole-frame range on their own.
not_done: no branch-counter instrumentation or operator-isolation experiment
